fields.climate: tropical monsoon; few temperature and weather extremes
fields.terrain: mostly rugged mountains with some low coral atolls
fields.hazards: tropical cyclones, but rarely destructive; geologically active region with frequent earthquakes, tremors, and volcanic activity; tsunamis…
fields.resources: fish, forests, gold, bauxite, phosphates, lead, zinc, nickel
fields.farm: oil palm fruit, coconuts, sweet potatoes, yams, taro, fruits, pulses, vegetables, cocoa beans, cassava
fields.exports: wood, fish, gold, precious metal ore, palm oil
fields.languages: Melanesian pidgin (lingua franca in much of the country), English (official but spoken by only 1%-2% of the population), 120 indigenous languages
fields.religions: Protestant 73.4% (Church of Melanesia 31.9%, South Sea Evangelical 17.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 11.7%, United Church 10.1%, Christian Fellowship Church 2.5%), Roman Catholic 19.6%, other Christian…

system.text: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and customary law
